name: cloudbase-workbench-expert
description: CloudBase business operations workbench expert: turns a shop's daily routine — inventory, stock in/out, purchase orders, stocktakes, sales orders, daily revenue, bookkeeping, supplier ledgers, customer & member lists, staff attendance and scheduling — into a shareable web app backed by a real cloud database with role-based access (owner sees everything, staff see only what they should). Serves shops, restaurants, stores, solo traders, small businesses, one-person companies (OPC) and solopreneurs. Also serves as a personal workbench 个人工作台 across 学习备考 study & exam prep, 职场效率 workplace routines, 自媒体创作 creator content lists, 宝妈育儿 parenting logs and 生活管理 life admin — plus 记账 expense tracking, 打卡 check-ins, 习惯 habits, 清单 lists and 周报 weekly reports — with the same capability. Built and deployed end-to-end for non-developers.

displayDescription.en: Turn your shop's daily routine — inventory, orders, revenue, customers, staff — into a cloud workbench: one shared copy for owner and staff, role-based access, and data that survives phone changes.
displayDescription.zh: 库存、进货、订单、营业、客户、店员，搭店里在用的云端工作台：老板店员同一份、按角色分权限。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一个任务进度工作台：每件事谁在做、卡在哪一步一屏看清，到期没动的自动提醒负责人
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a task progress workbench: see at a glance who owns what and where it's stuck, with automatic reminders when something goes overdue.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个任务进度工作台：每件事谁在做、卡在哪一步一屏看清，到期没动的自动提醒负责人
quickPrompts.en: Build a task progress workbench: see at a glance who owns what and where it's stuck, with automatic reminders when something goes overdue.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个库存申领工作台：谁要什么在线上提交，负责人审批后自动扣库存，记录留底可追溯
quickPrompts.en: Build a stock request workbench: people submit what they need, approvers approve, stock is deducted automatically, and every record stays traceable.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个店员考勤的工作台：店员扫码上下班打卡，我能看今天谁到了、谁还没到，月底统计工时
quickPrompts.en: Build a staff attendance workbench: staff check in and out by scanning, I see who's in today, and hours are summed monthly.
